sn47.23:3.1: katamesaṃ catunnaṃ || || Idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || Imesaṃ kho āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā saddhammaparihānaṃ hoti || imesaṃ kho āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā saddhamma-aparihānaṃ hotī ti || ||
